subject: Payband consensus & escalation: Senior Inference Lead (Aria Gomez)
messages:
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Payband consensus & escalation: Senior Inference Lead (Aria Gomez)

Hi team —

Quick summary: final debrief for Aria Gomez (senior inference lead candidate). Interview loop went very well; hiring manager recommends band 5.3 with an OTE-style offer composed of base + RSU + relocation allowance. Recruiting has run the market comp checks and the attached spreadsheet (aria_gomez_offer_calc.xlsx) contains the breakdown.

We need two things from this thread:
- Agreement on the payband and target base range (proposed: $215k–$235k base).
- Confirmation on whether to approve a one‑level band exception (+1 band bump) to land at the top of the range. This candidate has multiple competing offers and an ask for a greenband exception to match total comp.

Attachments: aria_gomez_offer_calc.xlsx (comp math) and proposed_band_chart.pdf (band mapping). Also link to the payband proposal sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1X9-payband-proposal

Asks:
1) Lauren — can you weigh in on the comp sanity and whether this fits current band policy?
2) Marissa — if we need an exception, can you route for compensation committee signoff?
3) Karthik — hiring manager signoff required (technical and budget).

Timing: candidate expects a final offer by EOD Monday Pacific. If we escalate to compensation committee, please advise timelines.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Inference Hiring
Redwood Inference

----


From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payband consensus & escalation: Senior Inference Lead (Aria Gomez)

Jonas — thanks for the packet and the spreadsheet. Quick notes:
- Base range $215k–$235k looks market-aligned for SF/remote-equivalent.
- Need to confirm banding language: is this a formal band 5 -> 6 bump or a one-off exception within band 5? If it’s a permanent band elevation for the role, that has org implications.
- Please add manager-level justification (one paragraph) for why Aria should sit at the top band — focusing on cross-team ownership and recruiting scarcity.

If we can keep it as an exception for this candidate rather than repricing the role, HR will be more comfortable approving quickly. Marissa — can you confirm committee availability Mon/Tue morning?

One last ask: include proposed RSU schedule (4-year, 25% cliff) in the calc sheet. I didn't see it spelled out.

—Lauren
VP, Talent Operations

----


From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 12:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payband consensus & escalation: Senior Inference Lead (Aria Gomez)

Thanks — I reviewed the calc. Some comments inline in the attached aria_gomez_offer_calc.xlsx (tab: committee_notes). High-level:
- Committee is available for a quick exception signoff on Monday 2027-05-24 at 10:00 PT if we submit the packet by EOD Monday.
- We can approve a one-off leveling exception (do not re-band the job) up to +10% of the top of band with a business justification and manager signoff. Anything beyond that requires exec-level exception (Lauren can confirm).
- Please add proposed RSU schedule and the relocation allowance values to the spreadsheet (Jonas: you suggested $10k in relocation).

If you want, I can start the intake form now so the committee has the packet for review — need final manager justification and Karthik’s confirmation on headcount budget.

Marissa Cole
Comp & Talent Programs

Attachment: aria_gomez_offer_calc.xlsx (committee_notes tab)

----


From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payband consensus & escalation: Senior Inference Lead (Aria Gomez)

All — reviewed interview feedback and the compensation packet. TL;DR: greenlight to proceed with an exception to land Aria at the top of your proposed range (base $235k) provided the following conditions are included in the offer:
1) Manager justification paragraph included in the packet (Jonas: I added a sentence below you can paste).
2) RSU schedule: 4y / 25% cliff; target grant to be finalized by total-comp math (Marissa will calculate).
3) Relocation: authorize $10,000 lump sum.
4) This is a one-time leveling exception (do not re-band the role). If candidate accepts and we see future similar needs, we'll evaluate the role banding separately.

Manager justification (for packet): "Aria's leadership on runtime optimization and prior production inference rollouts will reduce our token serving latency by an estimated 20% on critical paths. Given immediate roadmaps where she will own cross-team rollout, the candidate's unique combination of infra + applied ML justifies a make-whole compensation approach to secure hire."

Marissa — please submit the packet to committee for Monday 10:00 PT with these attachments: aria_gomez_offer_calc.xlsx (final), proposed_band_chart.pdf, and the manager justification note.

If committee approves Monday, Jonas — you may extend verbal offer and we can issue formal paperwork once committee signoff confirmed. Copy me on the extension.

—Karthik
SVP, Serving & Inference
